core_relation.sentence: The paper's whole case rests on a conjunction of ten claims that, if they all hold, form a single structure explaining the fights, why they don't resolve, and what resolution would require.
core_relation.quote: If those ten claims hold up under examination, they form a single structure — and that structure explains not just the fights you're having, but why you're having them, why they don't resolve, and what the resolution would require. [S061]

core_relation_run2.sentence: The ten claims are not independent topics but a single structure: if all ten hold up under examination, they jointly explain the unresolvable fights, why they don't resolve, and what the resolution would require; if the structure holds, resolution requires a point off the line (an external reference point), and if any claim fails, the whole structure fails.
core_relation_run2.quote: If those ten claims hold up under examination, they form a single structure — and that structure explains not just the fights you're having, but why you're having them, why they don't resolve, and what the resolution would require. [S061]

product_test.quote: If those ten claims hold up under examination, they form a single structure [S061]
product_test.reason: The paper explicitly frames the ten claims as jointly necessary to form 'a single structure' whose explanatory and prescriptive force depends on all of them holding. The conditional 'if those ten claims hold up' implies that failure of any one claim removes the structure, not merely weakens it. This is a conjunctive/multiplicative relation: the conclusion (the structure explains the fights and what resolution requires) is zero if any required claim is zero.

slots.plays_role: The external reference point that must exist outside any closed system for good/bad to be meaningful; the paper treats this as the negentropy-like input that a closed system cannot generate for itself.
slots.quote: That an external reference point must exist for the distinction between good and bad to be meaningful — and that such a reference point has maintained a continuous, accessible record throughout human history. [S044]

slots.plays_role: Alignment with the external reference point versus capture by institutions; the population sorts by whether their connection to truth runs through captured institutions or directly to the source.
slots.quote: That the population sorts into two classes over time, defined not by any demographic variable but by one structural feature: whether their connection to truth runs through the captured institutions or directly to the source. [S050]

slots.plays_role: Signal fidelity through communication technologies: each tech has a brief window where truth spreads before institutional capture of the infrastructure degrades the signal.
slots.quote: That every communication technology in history — writing, the printing press, radio, television, the internet, social media — follows the same pattern: a brief window where truth spreads, followed by institutional capture of the infrastructure. [S052]

slots.plays_role: Institutional capture and the ordered sequence of capture (money, government, education, interpreters of reality, moral language itself) act as the entropy that lowers coherence; also the 'deficit' that someone must eat.
slots.quote: That institutions get captured in a specific, documented, ordered sequence — money first, then government, then education, then the people who interpret reality for everyone else, then the moral language itself. [S046]

slots.plays_role: Historical trajectory and accumulation across civilizations; the same pattern repeating across civilizations that never communicated, and the measurable curve over time.
slots.quote: It has a history that shows the same pattern repeating across civilizations that never communicated. [S029]

slots.plays_role: The ten claims compress into 'a single structure' that explains many fights; the mathematical constraint (justice and mercy cannot both be fully satisfied in a closed system) is a compression of the moral problem.
slots.quote: That there is a mathematical constraint — provable by algebra — showing that justice and mercy cannot both be fully satisfied inside any closed system. [S054]

slots.plays_role: The 'exactly one event' where the trajectory reversed without collapse is a phase transition: a threshold event with measurable features that no other candidate matches.
slots.quote: That there is exactly one event in the recorded history of the world where this trajectory reversed without the system collapsing — and that event has measurable features that no other candidate in history matches. [S060]

slots.plays_role: The unresolved nature of the fights: positions stay open and unresolved until the 'point off the line entirely' is actualized; the line's constraint makes resolution impossible from inside, keeping the outcome in superposition.
slots.quote: And it has exactly one exit — which is not a better position on the line, but a point off the line entirely. [S030]

slots.plays_role: Non-local correlation across civilizations that never communicated yet show the same pattern; also the shared structure linking all the separate fights.
slots.quote: It has a history that shows the same pattern repeating across civilizations that never communicated. [S029]

slots.plays_role: The integrator is the reader/participant who must 'follow the argument, check the evidence, and see where it lands' — the local integration of the ten claims into one structure.
slots.quote: We are asking you to follow the argument, check the evidence, and see where it lands. [S063]

one_line: The Meta Argument's ten-claim conjunction maps onto the master equation as a multiplicative structure where an external reference (G), alignment/capture (M), signal fidelity through media (E), institutional entropy (S_eff), historical accumulation (T), compressed structure (K), a singular reversal event (R), unresolved line-position (Q), cross-civilizational correlation (F), and the reader as integrator (C) jointly determine whether resolution is possible.
breaks: The paper presents ten claims as jointly necessary, but does not explicitly state that failure of any single claim zeros the entire conclusion; the multiplicative reading is inferred from 'if those ten claims hold up' and 'they form a single structure', not stated as a formal product.
The 'external reference point' (G) is treated as a historical/religious fact to be established, not as an ongoing negentropy flux; the paper does not discuss sustainment dynamics.
Shame is described as the enforcement mechanism, which has no direct slot in the master equation; it may be an extra factor or an aspect of S_eff/M.
The paper's 'exactly one event' (R) is a historical singularity claim, not a general phase-transition mechanism; the analogy is stretched if R is meant to be a repeatable threshold.
The paper is a manifesto/prolegomenon; it states claims to be proven later, so many slot mappings are promissory rather than demonstrated.

The paper treats the ten claims as a structure but does not formally state a multiplicative law; the product test is inferred from 'they form a single structure' and the falsification demand, not from an explicit equation.

G is framed as a historical/external reference point with a continuous record, which is more concrete and testable than the abstract external negentropy influx of the master equation; the analogy may over-specify G.
S_eff is mapped to a moral/justice deficit and institutional capture, but the paper does not quantify entropy or show it as a multiplicative factor; it is closer to a constraint than a slot.
Q is stretched: the paper's 'line' is a set of positions, not a quantum-like superposition; the unresolved-until-actualized reading is interpretive.
F is stretched: 'same pattern across civilizations that never communicated' is a historical correlation, not a physical non-local correlation.
extra_factors: Shame as the enforcement mechanism deployed by governments since at least 2015 [S048] — no direct slot; could be mapped to S_eff or M but is presented as a distinct causal lever.
The ordered sequence of institutional capture (money → government → education → interpreters → moral language) [S046] — a specific ordering not captured by a single slot.
The 'point off the line entirely' as the only exit [S030] — a topological/geometric constraint that may be an extra structural factor beyond the ten slots.
Shame as enforcement mechanism: 'That the enforcement mechanism is not force but shame — and that governments have been deploying it as official policy since at least 2015. [S048]'
